g.text: Colorful parts surrounding the center. They
Green leaf-like parts beneath the petals.
They protected the flower bud before it opened.
Male reproductive part — has two parts:
Female reproductive part — has three parts:
The top part of each stamen. It makes
and releases millions of pollen grains!
Thin green stalk that holds up the anther
like a tiny flagpole on the flower.
Swollen base of the pistil. It contains
ovules that become seeds after fertilization.
Slender tube connecting the sticky stigma
at the top down to the ovary below.
Sticky top of the pistil. It catches
The base of the flower where all parts
attach, like a small platform or cup.
💡 PRO TIP — Order from outside to inside:
Sepal → Petal → Stamen → Pistil (stigma → style → ovary) → Receptacle
Click the tiles in the Word Bank above to highlight each part's position on the flower diagram!
✓ Answer Key — Match Labels to Flower Parts
WHERE IT IS ON THE FLOWER
Top of each stamen — yellow, pollen-maker
Thin green stalk beneath the anther
Slender tube from stigma to ovary
Sticky top of pistil — catches pollen
Base where all flower parts attach
📝 Drag each Word Bank label tile to its matching dashed slot on the flower diagram.
With JavaScript: tiles snap into slots. In this pure SVG: read the answer key above, then click tiles to see hints!
💡 Structure: From outside → inside: Sepal → Petal → Stamen → Pistil → Receptacle
Are you sure you want to reset?
All placed labels will be cleared and returned to the Word Bank.
ℹ️ How to Reset in a Static SVG (No JavaScript):
• Press your browser Back button to clear the anchor state
• Reload / refresh this SVG file (F5 or Ctrl+R)
• Right-click SVG → "Open in new tab" for a fresh copy
• Right-click → Save As to keep a local copy
💡 The interactive buttons (Hint, Check, Reset) use CSS anchor targeting — no JavaScript required!
